title: AI models is a row under the people in the list of chats
given: Any person in the app (Kasia, Tomek or Marta)
when: They open their list of chats
then: Under the people, a section “AI models” with one row “AI models” and “Teach one, or start your own”

title: The list shows the most mature models first, with who started each
given: Six models, one ready to use
then: “Each model learns one skill from people who know it well. The ones furthest along are at the top.”
The ready model first, with “Ready to use”, “Passed its final exam · 9 teachers”, “Use it” and “Teach it”
Each other model: “Started by …”, a bar, “… % of the way to its first training · … teachers”, “Teach it”, “Open”

title: Search and the three filters; an empty result says so
given: The list of models
when: They search for something no model covers
then: “Nobody has started a model about this. You could be the first.”

title: “For you” is chosen by the knowledge score, at 2.0 or more
given: Marta’s profile words
then: Only models whose words match her profile at 2.0 or more, and the ones she teaches
note: The score and the threshold are built for matching a Take to a person (take_match); matching a person to a model is not.

title: “What do I get?” in three short cards
given: The list of models

title: A public model’s door: teach only what you know well
given: Kasia does not teach Pitch feedback for founders
then: “Everyone who uses this model relies on what it learns from you.”
“Teach it only what you know well. If this is not your field, your answers would make it worse for all of us.”
“It learns from your ratings and the words of your answers. Your voice recordings stay with WillpowerLab.”

title: Teaching follows the recipe card: rate a clip
given: Marta teaches Speaking confidence
when: She opens her queue and taps “Start”
then: No machine guess, no Willfidence, no “Will would have said”
note: The coach panel’s Judge is built for speaking confidence; the launchpad’s teaching screens for other models are not.

title: Teaching follows the recipe card: pick, then answer in your own words
given: Kasia joined her company’s private model
when: She answers one of its examples
then: The question and the options from the list
“Your company’s own example: it teaches only …”
“Now say how you would answer them, in your own words.”

title: The one queue: every model a person teaches, the most helpful first, none starved, Pause
given: Marta teaches Speaking confidence, Interview voice and Job interview coach
when: She taps her row under Will, “Open your queue”
then: “… examples are waiting. The ones that help most come first.”
One row per model with its count and “Pause”
“Pause a model to stop its examples for a while. Tap a model to teach only it.”
note: The coach’s row opens the coach panel’s queue for speaking only; the one queue across models is not built.

title: An empty queue
given: Every model is paused, or nothing waits
then: “Thank you. New examples come when your models need you.”

title: One answer counts for two models only when both ask the same question on the same scale, on a public example
given: A clip that Speaking confidence and Interview voice both ask about
then: “Counts for Speaking confidence and Interview voice: both ask this question”

title: A different question about the same clip follows right after
given: A clip two models ask different questions about
then: “… asks something else about the same clip: …”

title: A company’s own example never counts for a public model
given: An example from Northwind’s own data
then: It counts only for the company’s model

title: The quiet trust check: known examples 1 in 4 of the first 20, then 1 in 10; admitted at 70% of the trusted median, never below 0.20
given: A newcomer on a public model
then: “You earn a token for each answer that counts. When businesses start paying to use this model, you also get a share of what it earns.”
note: Known clips and the quorum exist for speaking confidence; the measured admission per model is not built.

title: Two matching votes settle an example; one never does; a clash calls a third
given: An example with votes
then: One vote waits for a second; two matching settle; two different go to a third teacher

title: Starting a model in three chapters, Describe · Shape · Share, with a thin bar
given: Someone taps “Start your own”

title: After the first Take, the setup opens filled from its answers
given: Kasia recorded her first Take
then: The problem from “Your field”, how she solves it today from “Worth sharing”
Drafted: “Filled from your first Take. Change any word.”

title: ✕ keeps a draft, shown in the list with Continue
given: A setup half done
then: “You stopped at the scale. Nothing is lost.”

title: “A model like yours already exists” slides up over the third answer
given: Three answers that match a public model at 2.0 or more
when: They tap Next on the third
then: “If you teach it, it learns faster, and you share what it earns.”
note: The score is built for Takes; the sheet and the matching of a setup to models are not.

title: What it will do, the scale, the question and the list
given: The setup’s Shape chapter
then: “From your answers, your model will do three things. Untick what it should not do.”
“Start with this, finish the rest later”
Drafted: “Your teachers will be asked this about each clip. We wrote it from your answers; change any word.”

title: Each part gets the AI that fits it
given: A model that scores a voice, picks and answers
then: “Each part of your model needs a different kind of AI. We chose one for each.”
“WillpowerLab’s voice scorer: it learns from how the voice sounds, not only from the words”

title: Starting rules from research, each checked against the first 50 ratings
given: A study uploaded
then: “Do you have research your model should start from? It will work from day one on the rules you keep.”
“A study’s numbers may not fit your speakers. We check each rule against your teachers’ first 50 ratings. If they disagree with a rule, we stop using it and tell you why.”

title: Uploading a dataset: columns mapped, names left out, the checks, the consent, 60 re-rated before it counts, never in the exam
given: A spreadsheet of 1,240 rows
then: “→ Left out: it names a person”
“Rows we can use”, “Repeats removed”, “Near repeats removed”, “Rows with no score, skipped”, “Rows that look mislabelled”, “Names and places removed”
“I have the right to use this data, and the people in it agreed to its use for training.”

title: The final exam: 100 cases set aside by two experts
given: The exam step
then: “Before anyone teaches it, two experts set aside a final exam: 100 clips your model never learns from.”
“It can be sold only when it does clearly better on this exam than it does today.”

title: The founder answers the first 10; the model reads them from day one and trains on each once a second teacher agrees
given: The setup’s last Shape step
then: Drafted: “Now answer the first 10 yourself, the way your teachers will.”
Drafted: “None of these 10 goes into the final exam.”

title: Private or public, with a disclaimer before public; invites
given: The Share chapter
when: They choose who can see it
then: “Anyone will be able to see your model and teach it.”

title: The owner’s page: “Needs you now”, an honest range, agreement on 1 example in 10, folds
given: A model a few weeks old
then: “Your teachers disagree most between 3 (…) and 4 (…). Clearer words for those two points would help.”
“Within one point … times in 10 · exactly … in 10”

title: A version is released only when it is clearly better, and only by its founder
given: A training compared case by case on the 100 exam cases
then: “… is clearly better: a gap of 14 against 3 is very unlikely to be luck.”
“Had it been closer, say 9 against 6, you would see “Not clearly better yet”, and no Release button.”

title: The price with − and +, suggestions, the slider, and the split with Infrastructure
given: A released model
then: “Similar models charge €0.02 to €0.05. The lowest is €0.006, what an answer costs to run.”
“The AI company, our servers and WillpowerLab”

title: A teacher’s earnings: a share fixed per version, monthly payouts above €20, tokens until the legal terms
given: A teacher of a sold model
then: “We pay once a month when you have earned €20 or more. …”

title: A business: the model card, trying it, “sure”
given: A careers website owner
when: They open a ready model and try it
then: “I’m not sure about this one, so I won’t guess. One of the coaches who taught me will answer it here within a day.”

title: A business: the free test key, the monthly limit, the key shown once, the code
given: A business that wants to use the model
then: “Free for your first 100 answers. It never bills you.”

title: A business: usage, the questions it was not sure about, and pinned versions
given: A key in use; version 2 released
then: “Send the questions it wasn’t sure about to its teachers”
“You use version 1. When version 2 passes the same exam, you choose when to switch.”
Drafted: “Your test key used its 100 free answers.”

title: Downloading the data: ratings and answers, never recordings; speakers’ words only once the training yes says so
given: A model’s owner
then: “You can download what … has learned from, and build your own on it.”
“You may build on it, test it and research with it for free. To sell a product built on it, you need a licence, and its teachers share what that earns.”

title: The speaker’s training yes decides whether their Takes feed any model
given: Kasia, at the consent screens
when: She leaves “Help improve WillpowerLab” on, or turns it off later

title: An invite to teach stays in the chat after “Not now”
given: Someone invited to a private model
then: “… invited you to teach … with her.”
“You said not now. The invite stays here; open it whenever you like.”
